assertions.native_anchor_filter: Persisted builder_assertions excluding family=model; actual source/family list reported separately.

definitions.cohort_method: entry_id namespace, not lexemes.source (which identifies builder output)

limits: Counts measure persisted representation/evidence coverage, not semantic correctness.
Two-valued and three-valued domains are unresolved; neither is a zero.
Rule incidence counts available tables; it does not establish applicability or successful narrowing.
Source-native definition identities remain separate unless an explicit identity link exists.
Zero evidence or relation incidence on a bank proves lack of that recorded support, not that its meaning is unidentifiable.

model_state.interpretation: Accepted receipts and build-reported calls in this snapshot only; not a count of external calibration/probe attempts or future calls.

snapshot.digest_order: entry_id; assertion entry_id,ordinal; canonical JSON row plus newline
snapshot.transaction: BEGIN; all SQL reads in one SQLite read transaction

structural_zero_evidence.rule_semantics: Stored foundational POS rules assign GOOD=0 to nouns and SOMETHING=0 to adjectives/adverbs. They are explicit projection rules, not missing-data defaults. Conditional GOOD/BIG zero inferences require both the POS guard and absence of relevant target-bank evidence before defaults. Unclassified linked/candidate observations are conservatively relevant; omission is not zero. Actual firing/narrowing counts are above.
